description: Immutable data object representing group centers in the Fineract project, including properties like ID, name, status, hierarchy, associated members, options, and related calendar and financial data.

classes.name: CenterData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing groups (centers) with properties, constructors, and utility methods for creating and comparing instances.

methods.name: importInstance
methods.description: Creates a CenterData instance for import purposes with specified properties.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates a CenterData template with provided options and totals.

methods.name: withTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new CenterData instance by combining a template and a specific center.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Creates a new CenterData instance with specified core properties.

methods.name: withAssociations
methods.description: Creates a new CenterData instance with specified group members and meeting calendar.

methods.name: withClosureReasons
methods.description: Creates a new CenterData instance with specified closure reasons.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the center.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the center.

methods.name: getCollectionMeetingCalendar
methods.description: Returns the collection meeting calendar data.

methods.name: setDatatables
methods.description: Sets the datatable data for the center.
